Commentary.Commentary: Now the target is a stiff one but the wicket is good and it can be chased down. Ireland do have the batters to do so and with just the one spinner in the opposition, they will back themselves. Bangladesh on the other hand, need to make most of the new ball. Can they get early wickets? We will find out.

Ireland were not at their best with the new ball but the key for them was, they managed to pick wickets when needed. Andy McBrine and George Dockrell were excellent and so was Adair towards the end. Overall, Andy Balbirnie will be quite pleased with the performance.

That is a really good comeback from Ireland and they well and truly have the momentum as they head into the break! At one time, Bangladesh looked all set for over 300. Despite the loss of an early wicket, Tamim along with Najmul Hossain Shanto and Litton Das laid the platform. Tamim got to a half ton and was eyeing a ton but once he fell, wickets kept falling on regular basis. Mushfiqur Rahim and Mehidy Hasan did get things back on track but yet again Bangladesh lost wickets in heaps and have fallen well short of the mark.

OUT! TAKEN! That is the end of the innings! Bangladesh are bowled out for 274! A slower one on off, Mrittunjoy Chowdhury looks to loft it over mid off but hits it high up in the air and it is taken by Andy Balbirnie!

Commentary.Commentary: FIVE WIDES! That is a poor, poor delivery to begin with! Sprays this way down the leg side. Left alone. Lorcan Tucker had no chance. It goes down to the fine leg fence. Perfect start for Bangladesh.

Commentary.Commentary: Time for the action to resume! The players make their way out to the middle. Rony Talukdar and Tamim Iqbal are the openers. Joshua Little has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
Ireland (PLAYING XI) - Stephen Doheny, Paul Stirling, Andrew Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Mark Adair, Andy McBrine, Craig Young, Joshua Little.

Bangladesh (PLAYING XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Litton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Rony Talukdar, Towhid Hridoy, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mehidy Hasan, Mrittunjoy Chowdhury, Mustafizur Rahman, Hasan Mahmud, Ebadot Hossain.
TOSS - Ireland have won the toss and ELECTED TO FIELD!

A ton from Najmul Hossain Shanto overshadowed a ton from Harry Tector to help Bangladesh take a 1-0 unassailable lead in this ODI series. This is now the last game and Bangladesh will want to deal the series with a win. Ireland on the other hand, need a win if they are level it. Can they do so or will they go down to the side from Asia yet again?
... MATCH DAY ...
